use_case_summary: B2B SaaS company building an in-app chat assistant embedded in their desktop and mobile apps. Primary constraints: low-latency streaming responses (start-of-answer streaming desirable), lightweight model footprint to keep cost predictable, tight token budget for short user interactions. They plan to use hosted API for quick rollout, want simple SDK and examples for iOS/React Native. Also interested in conversation context caching (prefix caching) and ability to pin a lightweight fallback model for outages.
